name: mirage
text: Understood, that's worse than slow. The app recorded no crash, and a crash would be recorded, so Android itself is ending it. Your tablet (Android 10 Go, 2 GB) can't tell the app why, so I can't see the reason yet. The likeliest cause is memory pressure while Android recompiles the new version in the background right after an update. What to try: after installing, open the app once, let it die if it does, wait 2 minutes without opening anything else, then open it again. If it still closes on every open, restart the tablet once. Next I'm adding a launch trace so the next report shows exactly how far startup got before it closed.
